2608.01046.title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
2608.01046.paper_summary: The rapid spread of large language models (LLMs) across the web raises concerns about misinformation, academic integrity, automated content manipulation, and risks to vulnerable online communities. Existing transformer-based detectors, such as GPT-Sentinel, show promise but struggle to generalize to diverse model outputs and paraphrasing attacks, limiting their role in building trustworthy web ecosystems. This work introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a responsible AI-generated text detection framework leveraging DeBERTa-v3's disentangled attention to capture subtle structural irregularities in synthetic content. A central design principle is transparency: unlike black-box commercial detectors, DeBERTa-Sentinel exposes token-level explanations of its decisions, enabling affected stakeholders journalists, educators, and platform trust and safety teams to audit, challenge, and contextualize detection outcomes. Using the GLC-AIText dataset of 28,057 human and LLM-generated samples (GPT, LLaMA, and Claude) with a 60-20-20 split, DeBERTa-Sentinel achieves 98.21\% validation accuracy and surpasses the RoBERTa-Sentinel baseline from NeurIPS 2025, achieving 97.53\% test accuracy, 95.89\% precision, 99.33\% recall, and 99.53\% ROC-AUC, and maintaining a 0.665\% false negative rate. The model's interpretability reveals linguistic markers such as academic phrasing and formal transitions associated with synthetic text, directly supporting stakeholder needs for verifiable, auditable content-authenticity decisions. By advancing responsible detection methods that reduce bias and enhance explainability, DeBERTa-Sentinel promotes trustworthy, ethical, and human-centric AI systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION.
2608.01046.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在網路上的快速擴散引發了對錯誤信息、學術誠信、自動內容操縱以及對脆弱的線上社群風險的擔憂。現有的基於Transformer的檢測器，如GPT-Sentinel，顯示出潛力，但在對多樣化模型輸出和改寫攻擊的概括能力上存在困難，限制了它們在建立可信的網路生態系統中的角色。本研究介紹了DeBERTa-Sentinel，一個負責任的AI生成文本檢測框架，利用DeBERTa-v3的解耦注意力來捕捉合成內容中的微妙結構不規則性。一個核心設計原則是透明性：與黑箱商業檢測器不同，DeBERTa-Sentinel揭示了其決策的標記級解釋，使受影響的利益相關者如記者、教育工作者以及平台信任與安全團隊能夠審計、挑戰和上下文化檢測結果。使用包含28,057個人類和LLM生成樣本（GPT、LLaMA和Claude）的GLC-AIText數據集，並進行60-20-20的劃分，DeBERTa-Sentinel達到了98.21%的驗證準確率，超越了NeurIPS 2025的RoBERTa-Sentinel基準，達到了97.53%的測試準確率、95.89%的精確率、99.33%的召回率和99.53%的ROC-AUC，並保持了0.665%的假陰性率。該模型的可解釋性揭示了與合成文本相關的語言標記，如學術措辭和正式過渡，直接支持利益相關者對可驗證、可審計的內容真實性決策的需求。通過推進減少偏見和增強可解釋性的負責任檢測方法，DeBERTa-Sentinel促進了可信、倫理和以人為本的AI系統。代碼和數據可在https://github.com/Galileo-Galili/HUMAN-VS-AI-TEXT-DETECTION獲得。
